description.p: A small native GNOME player for FRISKY Radio's four channels: Frisky, Deep, Chill and Classics.

It shows the cover art and tracklist of the DJ mix currently on air, draws a live visualiser over the artwork, and integrates with the system media controls so you can play, stop and switch channels without opening the window.

This is an unofficial client. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by FRISKY. Channel names, artwork and audio belong to FRISKY and its artists. Streaming at 96 kbps is free; higher bitrates require a FRISKY subscription.
